name: seller.listing.countPublished
title: Profile: seller.listing.countPublished
description: Canonical profile for counting seller-owned published listings.
text:
# seller.listing.countPublished

TL;DR:
- Use seller.listingCount when you only need counts, not full listing payloads.
- Empty query is the fastest path for the seller's total published listing count.
whenToUse: When you want the number of published listings.
When you want a quick existence check before loading a full listing collection.
minimumInputs: No inputs for total count, or a public filter for filtered count
recommended: Use empty query for total published count.
Use filter.fulltext for one seller-side text slice.
avoid: Do not use listingCollection if you only need counts.
exampleInterpretation: total is the seller-owned total count before filters.
filter is the count under the provided public filter semantics.
